title: Not really effective for calming. But...ok as treats
text: Not really effective for calming. But...ok as treats. As treats these are good - all 8 dogs like them. I have two dogs who are nervous Nellies in thunderstorms and I tried these the other night to help them feel calmer. One dog did seem very slightly more relaxed, but still jumpy. The other dog.... absolutely zero effect on him. Still shaking, pacing and upset. I had to resort to half a Benadryl (per our vet, don't just randomly give your dogs OTC medications) and he was able to settle down and sleep a bit while the storm raged outside.
